short_blurb: From remodels to ground-up builds — your Long Beach general contractor.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to Long Beach. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout Long Beach, including Belmont Shore, Naples, Bixby Knolls, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Long Beach?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Long Beach building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Long Beach?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Long Beach rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Long Beach remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
